purpose: Hard pre-live gate registry for WF18 (Telegram gateway). While any P0/P1 item is unresolved, tools/wf18_activation_gate.js REFUSES to let deploy publish/activate WF18. DEC-161 resolved the rearchitecture blockers with named regression tests (mostly tests/test_wf18_real_topology.js). TELEGRAM-001 (public HTTPS ingress) is intentionally LEFT OPEN — it is operator infrastructure (sing-box / port 443), not a repository change — so the gate correctly stays CLOSED until the operator provisions ingress. Code is dispatcher-ready; it is not yet live-ready.
